stories.title: Germany is target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
stories.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Germany is the target of 'intensive' espionage after a suspected Russian spy was arrested, with several people alleged to have acted for Russia and other foreign powers detained in Germany this year. Germany has been one of Europe's biggest arms suppliers to Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

stories.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
stories.summary: A US judge ordered President Donald Trump to sit for a deposition by 11 December in his defamation suit against the BBC over a Panorama episode that stitched together two parts of his speech before the 2021 Capitol riot. Trump cancelled a 16 October deposition citing 'matters of national importance', and his lawyers have proposed a January window instead.

stories.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
stories.summary: The BBC reports on newborn twins struggling to survive in Yemen as conflict drives worsening hunger across the country. The story highlights how years of war have left hospitals and families short of the resources needed to keep malnourished infants alive.

stories.title: At least four dead after Storm Adam brings flooding to southern France
stories.summary: At least four people died and one was injured after Storm Adam triggered widespread flooding across southern France, including two women aged 86 and 26 found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region. Dozens of residents were moved into emergency shelters in Mouriès and Saint-Martin-de-Crau, and roads and rail lines were disrupted.

stories.title: Microsoft says its AI diagnostic system outperforms doctors on hard cases
stories.summary: A study published in Science found Microsoft's MAI-DxO system, which runs several AI agents as a panel of doctors, diagnosed complex New England Journal of Medicine cases correctly 83% of the time versus 36% for generalist physicians working alone. Microsoft is now testing the system with Boston's Beth Israel Deaconess and building a healthcare foundation model with Mayo Clinic.

stories.title: Websites worldwide hit by millions of attempts to exploit PHP flaw
stories.summary: Cybersecurity firms reported millions of exploitation attempts against a newly disclosed flaw in PHP, the language underpinning roughly 70% of websites, after governments and companies pulled sites offline to patch. The UK took 32 government services offline as a precaution and its NCSC sent 50,000 alerts while saying it had no reports of successful hacks.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, an agent built for work tasks
stories.summary: Anthropic released Claude Duet, an agent app on Claude Opus 5.5 that works in the background to build daily briefings and dashboards and suggest actions from a user's data. It is in research preview via waitlist for Pro and Max customers, connects to over 6,000 marketplace connectors, and requires approval for purchases made through Stripe Link or Shop Pay.

stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
stories.summary: Bloomberg reported that DeepSeek raised about $15 billion, one of China's largest funding rounds, two days after Washington ordered federal civilian agencies to remove its technology over security concerns. CATL and Tencent are among potential investors as the lab boosts spending on infrastructure and open models.

stories.title: Why Todd Monken's culture may explain the Browns' 4-2 start
stories.summary: cleveland.com examines how Todd Monken's leadership has reshaped the Browns' locker room, framing that culture as a major reason Cleveland is 4-2 and alone atop the AFC North. The piece lands as the team prepares for a home game against the one-win Titans.

stories.title: Browns sit first in AFC North but land anywhere from 11th to 23rd in power rankings
stories.summary: The 4-2 Browns lead the AFC North and own the tiebreaker over the teams tied with them, yet national power rankings this week range from 11th at Pro Football Talk to 23rd at NFL Trade Rumors, averaging out to 17th. Cleveland19's newswire notes the 12-spot spread as the strangest part of the weekly exercise.

stories.title: Browns look to keep the victory party going against the Titans
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature's Daily Dawg Chow notes the Browns are in first place in the AFC North and face the one-win Tennessee Titans next, with Cleveland playing watchable football outside of Week 1. The roundup also covers Harold Fannin's quiet-but-steady role and Quincy Williams' value as a free-agent signing.

stories.title: Ryan Day: 'Everybody's got to step up' with Julian Sayin injured
stories.summary: On his weekly radio show, Ohio State coach Ryan Day said everyone has to step up with quarterback Julian Sayin out indefinitely, and reiterated 'a foul is a foul' when discussing the treatment of receiver Jeremiah Smith. The Buckeyes are on a bye before visiting USC on Oct. 31.

stories.title: Film study: what Ohio State can learn from the Indiana win without Sayin
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors' film study breaks down the 19-15 win at Indiana and what it revealed about Ohio State's offense as the Buckeyes prepare for life without Julian Sayin. It focuses on the adjustments that will matter when the schedule stiffens after the bye.

stories.title: Ohio State likely to keep passing offense simple for Fahey or St. Clair
stories.summary: With Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair splitting first-team reps, Eleven Warriors reports Ohio State will likely simplify its passing game to make things easier for whoever starts at quarterback. The Buckeyes visit No. 16 USC on Halloween in their first game without Sayin.

stories.title: ESPN updates Ohio State game predictions after loss of Julian Sayin
stories.summary: ESPN's Matchup Predictor refreshed Ohio State's game-by-game win probabilities after Week 7 and the loss of Julian Sayin. The Buckeyes' remaining slate includes road trips to USC and Nebraska plus home games against Oregon and Michigan.

stories.title: Piastri: what made me fast last season is now my 'downfall'
stories.summary: Oscar Piastri said the driving techniques that helped him challenge for the 2025 title have become a liability under the 2026 regulations, speaking at the FIA press conference in Austin. He said the last triple-header felt closer to his old form after a difficult stretch in the McLaren MCL40.

stories.title: United States GP: Friday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
stories.summary: Motorsport.com has the full Friday run-down for the United States Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas, including practice session times, the Austin weather forecast and how to watch. The weekend opens F1's latest triple-header in the Americas.

stories.title: Freddie Slater to make F1 weekend debut in Audi FP1 sessions
stories.summary: Audi will put 18-year-old British F3 runner-up Freddie Slater in the car for first practice at the Mexico City and Sao Paulo Grands Prix, his first F1 race-weekend running. Slater, the first driver signed to Audi's development programme, also steps up to F2 with Invicta in 2027.

stories.title: Horner calls his Red Bull exit 'abrupt and quite brutal'
stories.summary: Christian Horner described his Red Bull departure as 'pretty abrupt and quite brutal' while speaking at the Autosport Business Exchange in New York. He was removed as team principal and CEO in July 2025 after 20 years and replaced by Laurent Mekies.

stories.title: Westerville man pleads guilty to sextortion, exploitation crimes involving minors
stories.summary: A Westerville man pleaded guilty to sextortion and exploitation crimes involving minors, 10TV reports. The case adds to a growing run of federal and local prosecutions over online child exploitation in central Ohio.

stories.title: Columbus-area weekend events for Oct. 22-25: pumpkin show, MMA and spooky fun
stories.summary: NBC4 rounds up central Ohio events for Oct. 22-25, led by the Circleville Pumpkin Show along with MMA and Halloween-themed happenings. It is the paper's weekly guide to what is worth leaving the house for around Columbus.

stories.title: Hilltop hot chicken joint expands to northeast Columbus
stories.summary: A hot chicken restaurant that started on the Hilltop is opening a second location in northeast Columbus, NBC4 reports. The expansion follows steady demand on the west side and puts the concept closer to the city's fast-growing northeast corridor.

stories.title: Haitians and advocates walk from Springfield to Columbus to protest ICE
stories.summary: Haitians and their advocates marched from Springfield to Columbus in protest of ICE enforcement, NBC4 reports. The walk follows months of heightened immigration enforcement and rhetoric aimed at Springfield's Haitian community.
